en.name: Mingyang Wang
en.team_since: In the research group since March 2025
en.description: Mingyang Wang at Hong Kong Metropolitan University. Research in sound detection, artificial intelligence and UAV systems for search and rescue.
en.intro: I work on UAV systems for search and rescue, with an interest in connecting sound perception, artificial intelligence and mission planning.
en.bio_before: I am a research assistant in
en.bio_after: ’s group at Hong Kong Metropolitan University, which I joined in March 2025. My work includes victim sound detection and localization, and user-triggered UAV dispatching for mountain search missions.
en.research_intro: My research brings together three connected areas.
research_descriptions: Detecting human sounds and localizing people in UAV-assisted search and rescue.
Exploring learning-based methods for sound perception and intelligent sensing.
Connecting user information, mission planning and UAV execution for mountain search.
en.publications_intro: Selected collaborative work on UAV-assisted search and rescue.
en.contact_intro: For research discussions on UAV systems, sound perception and search and rescue, please get in touch.
en.bio_education: I received my BSc (Honours) in Computer Science from HKMU in June 2026, following earlier studies in optoelectronics. Alongside my research, I co-founded GuTelligence, a smart-toilet health-monitoring project.
en.projects_intro: From research ideas to integrated software and hardware prototypes.

education.detail: Department of Electronic Engineering and Computer Science

projects.title: UAV Rescue System
projects.organization: Hong Kong Metropolitan University · Supervisor: Dr. Yalin Liu
points: Led the design and integration of three subsystems: an offline-first mobile application, a Python ground-station command-and-control platform, and an autonomous quadrotor.
Integrated ground-station search-path generation with UAV mission execution; the project included software verification and an outdoor autonomous-flight demonstration.

projects.title: GuTelligence
points: Led a smart-toilet health-monitoring prototype that connects an ESP32-S3 imaging module, cloud image analysis using CNN, U-Net and ViT models, and a cross-platform application.
Directed technical development and hardware–software integration toward pilot testing, with support secured through the university’s entrepreneurship programme.

experience.description: Research and technical support for the Space-Air-Ground Integrated Networks project, including UAV acoustic-sensing experiments, dataset construction and model training for the Sky-Ear system.

experience.context: Hong Kong Science Park, Sha Tin
experience.description: Developed and debugged smart-camera hardware and AI-based object-tracking and image-processing functions using OpenCV and FFmpeg for education and environmental-monitoring products.

certifications: HarvardX CS109xa: Machine Learning and AI with Python
Senior Application Engineer, Computer-Aided Design (Electronic CAD)

zh_CN.name: 王明洋
zh_CN.team_since: 2025 年 3 月加入研究团队
zh_CN.description: 王明洋，香港都会大学研究助理，研究兴趣包括声音检测、人工智能与面向搜救任务的无人机系统。
zh_CN.intro: 我关注面向搜救任务的无人机系统，探索声音感知、人工智能与任务规划的结合。
zh_CN.bio_before: 我目前是香港都会大学
zh_CN.bio_after: 团队的研究助理，于 2025 年 3 月加入团队。研究工作涉及遇险人员声音检测与定位，以及面向山地搜索任务的用户触发式无人机调度。
zh_CN.research_intro: 我的研究兴趣围绕以下三个相互关联的方向展开。
research_descriptions: 面向无人机辅助搜救，检测人员声音并估计声源位置。
探索基于机器学习的声音感知与智能感知方法。
将用户信息、任务规划与无人机执行相结合，支持山地搜索任务。
zh_CN.publications_intro: 围绕无人机辅助搜救开展的合作研究。
zh_CN.contact_intro: 欢迎就无人机系统、声音感知和搜救相关研究交流。
zh_CN.bio_education: 我于 2026 年 6 月取得香港都会大学计算机科学荣誉理学士学位，此前学习光电技术。研究之外，我还联合创办了智能坐便器健康监测项目 GuTelligence。
zh_CN.projects_intro: 将研究想法落实为软硬件协同工作的系统原型。
